reviews.text:
Staff, assistants and doctors are all very pleasant and helpful. They listened to concerns and addressed all issues. I’ve taken multiple dogs here. All services are upfront and asked before proceeding. I think the practice got sold but service is the same.

I even left a dog toy there and they called me about it. Very thoughtful and honest office.
Excellent service and friendly treatment, I highly recommend them. Thank you.

Absolutely love and appreciate this amazing clinic and everyone that works here. I’ve been going to this clinic for so many years. They’re always very welcoming, attentive, and loving. Even when I don’t have an appointment, they’ll fit us right in. Whenever I have questions or concerns, they’ll respond knowledgeably and make sure I understand. They even give you a gift bag with goodies for your pet and knowledgeable info based on what your pet got done. I definitely recommend this clinic ♥️

Rusty - 2yr Yorkie- presented with drooling, panting, lip smacking, constant swallowing, stretching neck, , trembling, really didn’t feel well - came on suddenly, not around frogs/poison, stopped playing with twin brother, ignored fav toys, wanted to be held or to hide under bed/sofa. Dr. Steph examined him thoroughly - manipulated every part of him, checked all vitals - still a mystery. We left - with instructions to monitor him closely. About 1 block from home - he barfed an enormous amount of stuff all over me and the mini-cooper. Seems all that attention and manipulation unstuck whatever was stuck. I wasn’t charged for the appt - this is the type of true concerned and loving care all of us wish for our pets. If you don’t have a vet or are concerned you and your precious tiny one(s) don’t get this type of special care - consider Pou Vet Group🥰

Yesterday, we were at Pou Vet Clinic with Oliver. It is always a fantastic experience. The staff is friendly and makes you feel like family. The facilities are spotless. Dr. Pou and his team provide top-notch medical care. They are highly knowledgeable, very understanding, and take the time to explain things clearly. I am very grateful for their professionalism and their love for animals! It is always a pleasure.
We have been bringing our Frenchies here since they were born. The service is always excellent. Our Tech Maya is the best, she is amazing with our babies. 5 Stars for Maya
Best VET in Miami. I recommended 1000000%. All the staff are amazing. Thank you for your dedication and professionalism!
thank you to the vet team. they all were very attentive and showed me they tryly care for our little ones.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Nancy! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …

Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Maria. We're glad you had a great experience with us!🐾🥰
 …
Very professional and excellent service 👏 …
They have gone above and beyond for my dog! They also have excellent communication and are open to answer any questions you may have.

I had an amazing experience at this vet clinic. I took my 9 year dog in for a dental cleaning and tooth extraction, and the entire team exceeded my expectations. The front desk staff was exceptional, so welcoming, kind, and helpful from the moment we arrived. The veterinary nurses and the veterinarian were all caring, professional, and took great care of my dog.

The clinic was very clean, and you can truly tell that everyone here loves animals and are passionate about what they do. They treated my dog with kindness and made me feel confident that she was in great hands. I couldn’t be happier with the care we received and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a compassionate, pet-friendly veterinary team.

Coco has been a patient for years.  I am always in awe at their astounding service.  From their nice greeting to their fast service, I am in absolute love with Dr. Pou and ALL his staff.  Highly recommend 🐾🦴 …

I have been taking my Great Dane to Dr. Pou and their staff since day one of having her as part of my family and even though we moved farther away I wouldn’t take her anywhere else. Thank you for your care and attention.
Great service. The doctor was very kind and the staff is super friendly.

First visit free, since we purchased our puppy at petland.. everyone was for the most part nice, location was clean; however no restrooms for human customers. They try to enroll you in pet insurance and some very expensive heartworm/tick/ flea combo.. they asses my puppy since there was nothing due at the moment. The vet let my 2 1/2 month old puppy fall from the very high exam table. WTH! Not going there again.
Dr  Secco and Ayleen are simply so professional, so caring highly recommend them. The whole office is wonderful
I have been bringing my dog here for 6 years and I won't go anywhere else. The vets and techs are always kind and efficient.
I have to say the service in this place is 5 stars. Everyone is extremely professional and friendly.
This team of professionals are amazing. They treat our dogs (Kai and Luca 🐶🐶) with so much love. …
Dr. Romero was excellent! So thorough!
The whole staff was very professional, caring and extremely supportive. Although my belove paw crossed the rainbow bridge, My gratitude to all you!

Thank you so much for the 5-star review Fabiola! Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care for every pet that comes through our doors, and it means a lot to know that we made a positive impact. We look forward to continuing to care for your beloved Bali!💖🐾 …

We took our puppy to his first visit and it was a wonderful experience! The office is very organized and they provided great service starting at my initial call to schedule an appointment. During the appointment, Sal did an amazing job with giving us detailed information and answering questions. The Dr. was amazing as well and answered all of our questions. They were very transparent as far as costs, and offered many options for payment. I am very happy with the entire experience!

I am here to add to my original review. We just took my puppy for an unplanned appointment due to a concern with his skin. Once again, we had a great experience. They were able to accommodate us quickly onto the schedule. Everyone we meet here is amazing and very helpful. All of the nurses and doctor are very patient in answering all of our questions- and we ask a lot!! Thank you Pou Vet Group for taking care of us :)

We take our 2 cats to Pou Vet group and we are always so grateful for the patience, kindness, and medical support. Our cats don’t love the vet, but all the staff and doctors are amazing at slowing down to their pace and giving them as many treats and gentle pets to make sure they only have a positive medical experience. Pou Vet group has been amazing from regular vet visit to more involved procedures such as dental and on-going cat asthma treatment. S/O to Drs. Cohen and Rodriguez and to Sal and Maia 🐱 but truly everyone is amazing and great!!!
Amazing experience every time! The team is incredibly caring, professional, and truly treats your pets like family. It’s honestly a pleasure bringing my pets here. Highly recommend!

We’ve had the privilege of working with Dr. Diana Romero as our dog’s veterinarian for the past three years, and I can honestly say she is exceptional in every sense of the word.

Dr. Romero combines deep knowledge with genuine compassion. She takes the time to explain things clearly, never rushes through appointments, and always makes space for our questions—no matter how small they may seem. That level of attentiveness has made a real difference in how confident and informed we feel as pet owners.

Our dog is a gentle but sometimes skittish rescue, and Dr. Romero has consistently shown remarkable patience and a hands-on, calming approach that immediately puts our fur baby at ease. It’s clear she truly understands animal behavior and meets each pet where they are.

When she moved to a new veterinary group, we didn’t hesitate to follow her—even though it meant going a bit out of our way. After visiting her new location, we can confidently say it was absolutely worth it.

If you’re looking for a veterinarian who is skilled, compassionate, and deeply committed to the well-being of your pet, Dr. Romero is someone you can trust.

They always try to accommodate same day appointment for me. I  have had several visits for my sick cat and they always help, nurses are also very nice and patience. I have received tremendous help from two doctor but Dr. Romero, above and beyond with all efforts and communication, incredibly professional and friendly.

Honestly, there is no better vet than this. The quality and care for the animals is nothing short of incredible! They dont try to over charge or scare pet owners and a very compassionate to your heart and pockets! This is where quality meets economy!
Very caring and efficient 💗

We had our first visit with Theodore and overall it was a great experience. The staff was very kind and welcoming, and we even received a nice goodie bag which was such a thoughtful touch.

Although the wait time was about an hour, I really appreciated that the team kept checking in on us and communicated throughout the process to make sure we were okay and didn’t need anything. That level of attentiveness made a big difference.

Thank you for taking good care of Theodore—we’ll definitely be back!
Very clean and pleasant visit. Everyone including Doctor were so friendly and answered all our questions with detail and offered a lot of excellent advice
Pou has been perfect.  They even referred me during an emergency.  They are kind and helpful, and their pricing is reasonable.  I cannot suggest them with more enthusiam.
I've been taking my Havanese to Pou Veterinary Group since I got him last year! The staff and vet are always polite, caring, and knowledgeable.
Had a great experience at Pou. Staff were amazing. Wiggles loved her visit. Thank you for taking care of her during her visit. ❤️
They are so caring and gentle here! I am always able to get an appointment quickly. Highly recommended
The attention was excellent thank you 👍🙏😎
I 💙  Sal! He gives me a bath and clips my nails, and makes me comfortable! He's my favourite purrson! …

Every time we take our dog Tango to Pou Veterinary it's a pleasant experience. I know that they genuinely care about my dog's well being. The staff is always very nice and professional. They take the time to listen to you and answer all of your questions. We have had 2 emergency visits with our dog Tango since we've had him. The doctor takes the time to talk to us and explain everything to us in a calming manner. I am so happy that this is Tango's vet. We feel that he is always going the be well taken care of. Tango loves going to the vet. A round of applause to Pou Veterinary Group!

Updated Review:

My 8 yr old goldendoodle, Tango recenlty had a splenectomy to reove a tumor on his spleen. Athough it was a very difficulty 2 weeks of home care and waiting for pathology results, the ENTIRE office satff made us fell so cared for. They really went above and beyond. The surgery went well with no complications. Dr. Mario Cabrera performed the complex surgery at Pou Veterinary. Both Dr. Cabrera and the vet techs at Pou Vet were exceptional and treated us like family. Dr. Stephany Rodriguez, a vet at Pou Vet guided us through the entire process  and answered all of our questions and concerns with such empathy and patience. This is the ONLY vet that I would ever trust Tango with. The front desk ladies are also always warm and welcoming. This enttire team is just the best. I am happy to say that Tango's pathology results came back negative for cancer. What a blessing!
